player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kakuena mushindu mujalame wa kusungula to. Kuata mudimu ne "[pile quantity]".
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Mwana {player_id}, Nketo te. Lumbu {col} iko kwenye mizingo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muanda wa tshibungi {pile_index} udi pambelu pa muaba.
invalid_move.non_positive: Udi ne bua kumbusha tshintu tshimue.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Otaweza kusambaza {quantity} kwenye lumbu {pile_index} (niko na {pile_count} pekee).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Muena manaya {player_id} uvua muangate tshintu tshia ndekelu!
